story.text: 그 뒤로 이상한 일이 생겼다. 원래 다른 노선을 돌던 하늘이, 자꾸 같은 편에 배정되기 시작한 것이다.
story.reading: geu dwi-ro i-sang-han il-i saeng-gyeoss-da. won-lae da-reun no-seon-eul dol-deon ha-neul-i, ja-kku gat-eun pyeon-e bae-jeong-doe-gi si-jag-han geos-i-da.
story.en: Strange things started happening after that. Haneul, who used to fly a completely different route, kept getting assigned to the same flight.

story.text: 동료들은 그가 굳이 이 노선을 자원했다는 걸 알고 있었다. 정작 하늘 본인은 그런 적 없다는 얼굴을 했지만.
story.reading: dong-nyo-deul-eun geu-ga gud-i i no-seon-eul ja-won-haess-da-neun geol al-go iss-eoss-da. jeong-jak ha-neul bon-in-eun geu-reon jeok eobs-da-neun eol-gul-eul haess-ji-man.
story.en: His colleagues knew he'd specifically volunteered for this route. Haneul himself, though, wore the face of someone who'd done no such thing.

story.text: 브리핑 룸에서 누가 지나가듯 물었다. '이번 달 스케줄, 또 이 편이네요?' '…그냥 자리가 비어서요.' 하늘은 서류에서 눈도 떼지 않고 대답했다.
story.reading: beu-ri-ping rum-e-seo nu-ga ji-na-ga-deut mul-eoss-da. 'i-beon dal seu-ke-jul, tto i pyeon-i-ne-yo?' '…geu-nyang ja-ri-ga bi-eo-seo-yo.' ha-neul-eun seo-ryu-e-seo nun-do tte-ji anh-go dae-dab-haess-da.
story.en: In the briefing room, someone asked in passing. 'Your schedule this month — this flight again?' '...There was just an open slot.' Haneul answered without even looking up from his paperwork.

story.text: 세 번째로 같은 손님과 마주친 날, 그는 속으로 생각했다. 이쯤 되면 우연이라고 하기엔 좀 뻔뻔한 것 같다고.
story.reading: se beon-jjae-ro gat-eun son-nim-gwa ma-ju-chin nal, geu-neun sog-eu-ro saeng-gag-haess-da. i-jjeum doe-myeon u-yeon-i-ra-go ha-gi-en jom ppeon-ppeon-han geot gat-da-go.
story.en: The third time he ran into the same passenger, he thought to himself — at this point, calling it a coincidence was starting to feel a little shameless, even to him.

story.text: '…또 마주치네요.' 복도에서 인사를 건네는 그의 목소리는 태연했지만, 귀 끝이 살짝 붉어져 있었다.
story.reading: '…tto ma-ju-chi-ne-yo.' bok-do-e-seo in-sa-reul geon-ne-neun geu-ui mok-so-ri-neun tae-yeon-haess-ji-man, gwi kkeut-i sal-jjak bulg-eo-jyeo iss-eoss-da.
story.en: '...We keep running into each other.' His voice, greeting her in the aisle, sounded perfectly calm — but the tips of his ears had gone slightly red.

story.text: 손님이 웃으며 '일부러 그런 거 아니에요?' 하고 묻자, 그는 살짝 당황한 얼굴로 답했다. '…그럴 리가요. 그냥 이상하게 자꾸 겹치네요, 스케줄이.'
story.reading: son-nim-i us-eu-myeo 'il-bu-reo geu-reon geo a-ni-e-yo?' ha-go mut-ja, geu-neun sal-jjak dang-hwang-han eol-gul-lo dab-haess-da. '…geu-reol li-ga-yo. geu-nyang i-sang-ha-ge ja-kku gyeop-chi-ne-yo, seu-ke-jul-i.'
story.en: When she asked, smiling, 'Are you doing this on purpose?' he answered with a hint of flustered denial. '...No way. It's just — the schedules keep overlapping strangely, that's all.'

story.text: 정작 그날 밤, 하늘은 다음 달 스케줄표를 펴놓고 한참을 들여다봤다. 손님이 타는 편을 찾는 데, 예상보다 오래 걸리지 않았다.
story.reading: jeong-jak geu-nal bam, ha-neul-eun da-eum dal seu-ke-jul-pyo-reul pyeo-noh-go han-cham-eul deul-yeo-da-bwass-da. son-nim-i ta-neun pyeon-eul chaj-neun de, ye-sang-bo-da o-rae geol-li-ji anh-ass-da.
story.en: That night, though, Haneul sat with next month's schedule spread out in front of him for a long while. Finding the flight she'd be on didn't take him nearly as long as he expected.

words.example_en: It happened too often to be a coincidence.
I ran into him in the hallway.
Something feels a bit strange today.

sentences.en: They say he volunteered for this route on purpose.
We meet too often for it to be a coincidence.
We ran into each other in the aisle again.

sentences.ko: 귀 끝이 붉어진 게 좀 이상했어요.
sentences.reading: gwi kkeut-i bulg-eo-jin ge jom i-sang-haess-eo-yo
sentences.en: It was a little strange how the tips of his ears turned red.
